note_en: Chinese often uses a 由于… / 因此… pair or a cause-before-effect order where English might start with the result: 由于人口老龄化加快，领养老金的老人越来越多 "Because the population is aging faster, more and more people are drawing pensions." Also notice 越来越 + adjective for "more and more": 越来越多 "more and more (of them)", 越来越大 "bigger and bigger."
